items.title: Puka Nacua: Expected to play in Australia
items.description:
Rams head coach Sean McVay said Sunday that Nacua (groin) is expected to play Thursday against the 49ers in Melbourne, Australia, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Looks set to miss Sunday's practice
items.description:
Henderson (ankle) was in street clothes ahead of Sunday's practice and appears likely to be listed as a non-participant on the Patriots' first injury report of the season, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.
